subject: A free "Your Brain vs AI" session for BMU's new Wellness Centre
body:
Dear Ms Murghai and the Wellness Centre team,

Congratulations on opening BMU's Wellness Centre this month. The peer wellbeing mentor programme and the stress-management workshops are exactly the kind of support students need right now.

I work on a closely related problem. Students now have AI tools that write, summarise and answer in seconds, but very few are taught how to keep their own attention, memory and judgement strong while using them. I run UnAI Labs, where I teach short, science-backed courses on AI literacy, neuroplasticity, deep focus and brain health, in plain language.

I would like to offer BMU a free 45-minute session, "Your Brain vs AI", for any batch you choose, online or on campus. It is based on published research and leaves students with three habits they can use the same week. I would also be glad to brief your peer mentors afterwards.

Would a slot in November or December suit your calendar?

Warm regards,
Manish Kumar Singh
Founder, UnAI Labs
unai-labs.com

If you would rather not hear from me again, just reply "no thanks" and I will not write again.
